summary.headline: Data Scientist | Web Developer
summary.text:
I design and develop data-driven digital solutions that improve decision-making, operational efficiency, and business performance. With two (2) years work experience in Data Science and Engineering, Data Analytics, Systems Integration, Data Migration, Dashboard Development, Business Intelligence, and Software Development, with practical application across banking, fintech, and digital environments. 
I work with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, APIs and Web Services, AI technologies, and modern web development stacks to build reliable data pipelines, interactive dashboards, analytical systems, and scalable digital applications. I am particularly focused on transforming operational and business data into accessible, actionable insights and efficient digital solutions. 
With hands-on experience in core banking operations, performance reporting, data management, systems development, and business intelligence, I combine analytical thinking, prompt engineering, and modern UI/UX principles to create scalable, user-focused products that deliver measurable business value. Location State of Residence: Federal Capital Territory Region: North Central LGA: Municipal Area Council (AMAC) Address: A10 Gishiri, Opp Police Station, Maitama Extension, Nicon-Junction. Country: Nigeria

experiences.description: Supported the organization’s technology operations, i build, develop and monitor digital systems, web and mobile applications to improve operational efficency. My role involves providing technical support, managing IT-related incidents, supporting internal digital operations, improving user experience across all our products and services, contributing to the development of IT governance and operational processes. I also worked extensively with business and operational data, developing performance reports, KPI dashboards, and data-driven insights using dashboard tools to support management decision-making and organizational performance monitoring.

Founded and run a technology-focused academy, that trains students with practical education in data science, web development, digital skills and certification courses. Currently graduated 2 students with awarded certifications in data analytics and business intelligence.
achievements: Conduct technical training and classes focused on practical application in data analysis.
Mentor and guide students through structured learning paths, practical projects, and portfolio development.
Setup physical and virtual classes for students, training from beginner to foundational and intermediate concepts in data analysis, Python, web development, databases, and related technologies.
Provide training materials, exercises, projects, and learning resources to support technical skill.
Supervise student projects and provide technical feedback, code reviews, and guidance throughout their course programme duration.
Manage Aceth academy's learning activities, course certifications, curriculum development, and overall technical direction.

Built a production-style serving and visualization layer featuring a live dashboard portal with authentication, KPI cards, interactive charts, and filtered views.

Prepare periodic business reporting and analysis (monthly, weekly, and daily), develop live performance dashboards, data entry & migration, design staff incentive calculators, analyze client and customer traffic, and deliver business trend insights to drive growth and expansion.

Completed NYSC with a construction company, in the procurement through order requisition, sourcing of materials and services, price comparison sheets, supplier management, contract negotiation, market analys is to ensure quality, cost-effective, timely project delivery and general office management.
Service provider/graphics designer, working with MS office packages, Typing, online payments/registrations, Corel Graphics Suite, Printing/Photocopying and other office related tasks

portfolio.aboutSummary:
With 2+ years of hands-on experience across Data Science & Engineering, Data Analytics, Systems Integration, Data Migration, Business Intelligence, Dashboard Development, and Software Development, I build reliable systems that connect data, technology, and business objectives.

I work with Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, APIs, AI technologies, and modern web development stacks to develop analytical systems, interactive dashboards, data pipelines, and scalable digital applications. My experience spans banking, fintech, and digital environments, giving me practical insight into operational processes, performance management, data systems, and technology-driven business transformation.

I’m particularly interested in transforming raw operational and business data into actionable insights while creating user-focused digital products that deliver measurable value. I combine analytical thinking, prompt engineering, software development, and modern UI/UX principles to build solutions that are both technically sound and practical to use.
